Sound familiar?

Your strategy isn’t the problem. Your process is.

  • You take the trade first and work out the stop after.
  • One red day turns into three revenge trades.
  • You’ve switched strategies more times than you can count.
  • You don’t journal, so the same mistakes keep coming back.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why you don’t need another strategy

What separates a set-up from a process, and why switching systems keeps you starting over.

The risk rules that come before every entry

Position size, a max daily loss and a hard stop, decided before the market opens, not during the trade.

The pre-market checklist

What to check before the open so you trade your plan instead of the first candle you see.

How to journal so it changes your next trade

What to log, what to ignore, and how to spot the patterns that keep costing you.

The weekly review that builds your edge

Process, progress, consistency: the review loop I use every week, the same way you’d program a training block.

Meet Tanner

Hi, I’m Tanner Owings

I’m a full-time futures and options trader with over 7 years of experience. I teach futures, options and the process of how to build your edge as a trader.

Outside the charts I’m a powerlifter with a 1740lb total across squat, bench and deadlift. Nobody builds a total by guessing. You follow a program, log every session and review it. That’s exactly how I approach trading, and it’s what this class is about.

Before you grab your seat

Is this for beginners?

Yes, if you’ve placed a few trades and know the basics. The process works whether you trade futures, options or both.

Will you give trade signals?

No. This is education on process: risk rules, preparation, journaling and review. You make your own decisions.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Everyone who signs up gets the replay.

Is this financial advice?

No. It’s education only. Trading involves substantial risk of loss, and nothing in the class is a recommendation to buy or sell anything.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-head scripts, 30 to 45 seconds each, shot the way you already film your reels.

Script 1 · “Another strategy”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you’ve switched strategies three times this year, the strategy probably isn’t the problem.”

Body

“Most traders I talk to don’t have a set-up problem. They have a process problem. No risk rules before the open, no checklist, no journal, no review. So every week starts from zero. A process is what lets you see what’s actually working.”

CTA

“I’m teaching my whole process in a free live class. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera in your cap, on-screen text “PROCESS” highlighted in blue.

On-screen and caption: Trading involves substantial risk of loss. Education only, not financial advice.

Script 2 · “The program”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Nobody adds 50 pounds to their squat by guessing. So why trade that way?”

Body

“In the gym you follow a program, you log every session, and you review it every week. That’s how I approach trading too: rules before the open, a journal after the close, and a review every weekend. Same discipline, different arena.”

CTA

“I break the whole thing down in a free 60-minute masterclass. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: open in the gym under the bar, cut to you at the desk with your journal.

On-screen and caption: Trading involves substantial risk of loss. Education only, not financial advice.

Script 3 · “The red day”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The most expensive trade is usually the one right after a red day.”

Body

“That’s the revenge trade. It doesn’t come from your strategy. It comes from not having a rule that says ‘done for the day’. A max daily loss, written down before the open, takes that decision out of the moment.”

CTA

“I’ll show you the rest of my risk rules in a free live class. Tap Sign up to grab a seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a close-up of a written risk rules sheet.
